name: Cristóvão 'Cris' Abegão
badges: Mentored by Christina Chin & Alex Stojkov
bio: My name is Cristóvão Abegão, but you can call me Cris! Was born in Portugal on 1994 and have been living in Canada for the past twelve years. I am a Professional Pickleball Coach at some of the biggest and most private gyms in Canada. My mission is to elevate your Pickleball game, something I take very seriously and passionately. I was mentored by some of the best professionals in Canada, Christina Chin, a CNPL Pro player and Influencer (also known as “Pickleball On Ice” on instagram) and Alex Stojkov, one of the best Pickleball coaches in the world and one of the creators of some of Canadian Pickleball Instructor courses. I pride myself in being very observant, I can notice what players are doing in real time and give them feedback to adjust on the spot to improve their technical and strategic decision making skills. I have experience coaching from the ages of 5 and up. Doubles Pickleball is my specialty, my doubles skill level is 4.5 to 5.0. Providing personalized feedback to each player is why I have been excelling at my profession for the past 4 to 5 years.
shortBio: Professional Coach in Canada mentored by Christina Chin & Alex Stojkov. 4.5–5.0 doubles specialist known for observant, on-the-spot adjustments.
certifications: Mentored by Alex Stojkov & Christina Chin

name: Sarah Reynolds
bio: With a background in competitive tournament play, Sarah breaks down the mental game and positioning strategies that separate intermediate from advanced players. She specializes in doubles strategy and supportive player development.
shortBio: Specializes in doubles strategy, court positioning, and building confidence under game pressure.

name: James Torres
bio: James specializes in joint-friendly movement, footwork, and injury prevention. His clinics have helped hundreds of players 40+ continue playing pain-free with effortless shot mechanics.
shortBio: Movement specialist focusing on efficient footwork and injury-free mechanics for 40+ players.

name: Linda Chen
bio: Linda transitioned from competitive racket sports into pickleball coaching. She leads women's clinics with a teaching style that is patient, detailed, and results-oriented.
shortBio: Patient, detailed, and encouraging coach specializing in women's clinics and kitchen play.
